//: The Go interface's sections. `packages`: what each internal/ package may import of the others (cmd/ may import any). `tui`: internal/tui is one package, so its sections are file prefixes; every non-test file starts with one. Tests take their file's name; tests spanning sections start with suite_. Under internal/core each package is its own section (core/<pkg>; docs/continuation/GO_ENGINE.md). See docs/continuation/CODEBASE.md.

tui.core: The Bubble Tea model, its update loop and input routing: state, agent events, keys, mouse, paste, click zones, the screen's composition, the action registry, the rate-limit forecast
tui.chat: The Chat window: the conversation and its cursor, items, the input and its suggestions, approvals and questions, selection, scrolling, steering a running turn
tui.home: The home screen before the first message: the desktop's icons, the card, the first-run welcome and walkthrough, the tour panel
tui.desk: The desktop and the parts every surface shares: the floating glass window and its hint bar, lists, tile grids, the bars by keyboard, start menu, Finder, overlays, wallpaper and photographs, Sixel
tui.app: One window each (app_<name>.go, its parts app_<name>_<part>.go): Changes, Files, Pager, Gallery, Keys, Providers, Settings, Stats, Tasks and Notifications, Tour, Sessions, Models, Themes, Wallpaper, Help
tui.dialog: Questions that must be answered over a window: connect a provider, pick a mode
tui.cmd: Slash commands: the registry, custom commands, session commands, and the commands that run git, worktrees, review, rewind, goals, dev tools and handoffs
